Concept development

A village made for gathering.

Based on Option 1, Gingerbread Cookie Workshop, and the classic gingerbread element selections in the Event Proposal.

  • 12 × 12 m event footprint
  • Approx. 5 m central tree; eight secondary trees
  • Four decorated entrances
  • Santa house and bakery at the rear
  • Teddy photo corner and cookie-decorating tables
  • Gingerbread cladding, raised icing, muted pastel ornaments and warm-white lights

The concept visual shows the intended look and atmosphere. The 3D model shows the spatial layout; details may differ between the two. Neither is a fabrication drawing. Furniture positions and mall architecture are inferred; circulation, structural details and exact dimensions require design approval.
